description: This Java class 'DeviceCertificateValidator' implements the 'X509CertificateChainValidator' interface to validate device X.509 certificate chains against trust anchors using PKIX validation with Java's security libraries.

classes.name: DeviceCertificateValidator
classes.description: A class that validates the certificate chain of a device using Java's certificate validation mechanism and TrustAnchors, providing a method to asynchronously verify the chain's validity.

methods.name: validate(List<X509Certificate>, TrustAnchor)
methods.description: Validates a certificate chain against a single TrustAnchor asynchronously.

methods.name: validate(List<X509Certificate>, Set<TrustAnchor>)
methods.description: Validates a certificate chain against a set of TrustAnchors asynchronously.
